beats.name: attention
beats.line: The warning’s in the room. He asks: what’s new?

beats.name: doubt
beats.line: His plan is suspect — by its private light.

beats.name: test
beats.line: He tests it once, then twice, until it’s true.

beats.name: measured march
beats.line: He walks, and every step must prove he’s right.

beats.name: joy deferred
beats.line: He names the work with all the work to do.

beats.name: threat seen
beats.line: His eye stops on a trigger long since set.

beats.name: fear, held
beats.line: Now danger has a face — in time it came.

beats.name: pause
beats.line: He stops: the plan has not been questioned yet.

beats.name: aim
beats.line: He spares the table: habits take the blame.

beats.name: relief
beats.line: He breathes. The near miss, he admits, is his.

beats.name: rule
beats.line: He lifts his head — and writes a rule from this.

beats.name: repair
beats.line: He rights the habit. Table stays as is.

beats.name: earned joy
beats.line: The smile returns. No sparkle. Now, hindsight.

beats.name: practice
beats.line: He walks, and every step must prove he’s right.
